name: 60436 · Joliet, IL
findings: ZIP 60436 (Joliet) has 75 nonprofit organizations. 25 of them (33%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 22 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (32% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 60436 (Joliet) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 60436 (Joliet) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.6 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 13 organizations here; 13% of all organizations here have no identified type.
